_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_greatest_count_reduction.py. t_gc_greatest is Cavern-Hoard Dragon's price -- greatest_count over the artifacts an opponent controls, a per-player maximum. t_gc_sum is the identical card written with `count`, the near miss: it sums one flat pool, so it is right at two players and wrong at a pod, which is what makes the distinction measurable rather than argued. t_gc_bauble is a plain artifact and t_gc_ogre a plain creature, so the filter has something to reject.

cards.name: Test Greatest Opposing Hoard
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the greatest number of artifacts an opponent controls.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Test Summed Opposing Hoard
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each artifact your opponents control.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Test Greatest Hoard You Control
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the greatest number of artifacts you control.
Draw a card.
